note: The F281 batch: docs/research/2026-11-01-f281-broken-documents.md and docs/research/2026-11-01-f281-triage.md. "id" is filled by the supervisor with the full document id; "prefix" is its first 8 characters. Every Regulatory repair reads the official PDF, never the client pack text (the truncation is in the pack). source_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the official file as fetched on 2026-11-01; null means not fetched yet: prepare records it and pin writes it here after a look. Rekey titles, houses and statuses are the sansad listing record of the bill the text really is (a sibling record for the three synopses); the desk record name, when prepare reads exactly one, takes precedence. Filling ids or pinning PDFs changes the manifest, so build and dry-run must be run again before write (the write confirmation names the SHA-256 of build/review.json). old_text_garbage marks a stored text too damaged for its overlap with the new text to be measured; allow_missing_desk marks a re-key whose key may have no desk record; new_bill_number/new_bill_year give the bill number the text prints, for the identity check of a retitle_unlink.
